metric_definition: Per-document value F1, averaged with equal weight per document, from the official ExtractBench harness
harness: official ExtractBench harness (llama-extract-bench); version not recorded
notes: Imported from an internal results summary posted 2026-11-12; not re-run in this repository.
extract-20261111 ran with grounding enabled. The grounding setting for extract-20260903 was not stated.
Grounding F1 (word/page level), precision/recall per split, and % perfect were not reported and are still missing.
Cost is LLM cost per document, not the leaderboard's cost per page at public list prices, so it is not directly comparable to the leaderboard's cents-per-page column.
The Parse model used underneath Extract was not recorded.
No per-document outputs or evaluation reports are available yet, so predictions are not published here.
A follow-up change that runs grounding and extraction together (to cut latency) was merged to staging after this run; a re-run is pending.
The official 30-minute per-document limit: long-split p90 latency for extract-20261111 was 1,248 s (~21 min); max latency was not reported, so whether any document hit the limit is unconfirmed.
